title: CYCLIC-POLYSPACE-BALANCED: recomputed half-radicand blocks with explicit 3/2 time and 3/4 sample coefficients

Jointly on every execution branch its total paid work T has the structured full big-O envelope in this claim, with absolute outside constants. The eventual positive representative uses n>=64 and positive finite-prefix extension; correctness includes every N. Subset-sum root retries, signed-label low-prefix invariance, all odd-modulus scored backward recovery, 2-adic parity, exact original-copy transforms, fixed collective label precision, literal cap Qcap=4096 Croot(Fseed+H Kback+2a2+1), every failure/discard/abort and paid addressing are included. All four resources and epsilon=0 concern exactly the same configuration. No noisy-input or maximum tolerance guarantee is asserted. The actual fixed block width is the least integer b0 with 2 b0^2>=n ceil(log2(n+2)); rmax,kmax,R,ell and every literal cap and confidence are recomputed with it. The complete proof explicitly bounds the leading sqrt(n log2 n) coefficients by 3/2 in paid time and 3/4 in raw acquisitions.
